verdict.rationale: Ollama's cloud pricing page explicitly claims 'dedicated capacity so throughput holds up when running several agents at once' and separately advertises running multiple models concurrently, directly matching the story. However this is a first-party marketing claim tied to a paid cloud tier with no independent benchmark or hands-on report confirming steady throughput under concurrent multi-agent load. Missing for 10: independent load-testing/benchmark evidence of concurrent throughput, technical detail on how capacity reservation is implemented, and confirmation this applies to local (non-cloud) usage.
